name: Golden Magical Track
slug: A golden magical track embedded through the ship marks the path of a magical discharge.
description: A thin, golden, semi-fluorescent line embedded through the ship along the path of a magical discharge. It resembles a lightning track but does not leave a burnt or damaged crevice.

log.summary: A magical discharge left a thin, golden, semi-fluorescent line embedded through the ship. The line follows the path of the magical event like a lightning strike, but the ship shows no corresponding burn or physical damage.
notes: A thin, golden, semi-fluorescent line remains embedded through the ship along the path of the magical discharge.
